universityName: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

officialLinks.label: Undergraduate grading system and GPA calculation

helpIntro: UNC-Chapel Hill uses a 4.0 plus/minus scale. Enter UNC credit hours and final grades to estimate your current, cumulative, projected, or target GPA.
helpNote: For the standard undergraduate UNC-Chapel Hill record. PS and LP are excluded, F counts as zero, and all graded repeat attempts remain in the cumulative GPA. Graduate and professional grading systems need separate review.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.0 quality points and a 3-credit B- earns 8.1. Together, 20.1 ÷ 6 = 3.350.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.7 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.3 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1 grade points per credit hour.
gradeExplanations.F: Fail; counts as zero quality points.
gradeExplanations.FA: Fail for attendance; permanent failing grade.
gradeExplanations.F*: Unresolved incomplete/absence converted to failing grade.
gradeExplanations.IN: Incomplete; temporarily calculated as F until a permanent grade is assigned.
gradeExplanations.AB: Absent from final; temporarily calculated as F until a permanent grade is assigned.

specialTypes.name: UNC course, standard undergraduate grading
specialTypes.note: Use the posted UNC grade and course credit hours.

specialTypes.name: Transfer credit from another institution
specialTypes.note: Transfer grades and attempted hours are not included in the UNC GPA.

specialTypes.name: Interinstitutional / special external enrollment
specialTypes.note: Confirm the UNC transcript conversion before calculating.

repeatPolicy.note: Enter each graded attempt as a separate completed course. Repeat Impact is disabled because UNC counts all attempts in cumulative GPA.
